from common import *
import ast
P=ROOT/'backtest/experiments/models/training-target/quantile-n-p50-20261107-v1/docs'
s=read(P/'adapter-evaluate_single.json')['source_text']
s=s.replace("    check(read(PROGRESS)['source_amendment'])\n    for receipt in read(BASE/'docs/supplemental-control-inputs.json')['verified_files']:check(receipt)\n","    check(read(PROGRESS)['prepared_inputs'])\n")
s=s.replace("BASE/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz'","PREVIOUS/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz'")
start=s.index("    control_receipt=BASE/'docs/control-evaluation-verification.json'")
end=s.index("    bundle=ROOT/",start)
controls="""    control_receipt=BASE/'docs/control-evaluation-verification.json'
    if control_receipt.exists():
        for r in read(control_receipt)['artifacts']:check(r)
    else:
        specs=[]
        for h in [7,15,20]:
            proof=read(PRIOR/'docs'/f'sources-h{h}.json')
            components=[{**c,'prediction':fingerprint(ROOT/f'backtest/result/20261105_horizon_p50/h{h}'/f'{c["session"]}_pred.pkl')} for c in proof['components']]
            specs.append((f'h{h}continuous',components,PRIOR/'metrics'/f'h{h}-model.json'))
        for name,treatment,reference in [('h20q10','new',PREVIOUS/'metrics/quantile10-new.json'),('v5','old',CURRENT/'metrics/model-evaluation.json')]:
            specs.append((name,read(PREVIOUS/'docs'/f'predictions-quantile10-{treatment}.json')['components'],reference))
        artifacts=[];proofs=[]
        for name,components,reference in specs:
            preds={};sessions=[]
            for c in components:
                check(c['model']);check(c['prediction']);p=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/c['prediction']['path'])
                preds[c['session']]=p.iloc[:,0] if isinstance(p,pd.DataFrame) else p;sessions.append((c['session'],c['seed']))
            assert [x[1] for x in sessions]==SEEDS
            actual=evaluate(preds,sessions,name);prior=read(reference)
            x=actual['pools']['all']['ensemble'];y=prior['pools']['all']['ensemble']
            for key in ['net_ann','net_ann_vol','net_sharpe','ann','turnover']:
                assert abs(x['head']['3']['5'][key]-y['head']['3']['5'][key])<1e-12,(name,key)
                for block in ['head_years','head_regimes']:
                    for label in y[block]:
                        assert abs(x[block][label]['3']['5'][key]-y[block][label]['3']['5'][key])<1e-12,(name,block,label,key)
            assert abs(x['h5']['rank_ic_mean']-y['h5']['rank_ic_mean'])<1e-12
            out=BASE/'metrics'/f'{name}.json';write(out,actual);artifacts.append(fingerprint(out))
            proofs.append({'name':name,'reference':fingerprint(reference),'components':components,'exact_metric_match':True})
            del preds
        write(control_receipt,{'controls':proofs,'artifacts':artifacts,'canonical_tolerance':1e-12,'same_source_H20':'h20continuous and h20q10 use Nov3 labels; v5 uses old-label source and is formal historical baseline only'})
"""
s=s[:start]+controls+s[end:]
s=s.replace('20261107_quantile_n','20261107_pathsum_quantile10')
s=s.replace("'note':'Label-grading five-seed signals and paired source perturbation'","'note':'Path-sum and q10 horizon study; four five-seed signals'")
start=s.index("        result=evaluate(preds,sessions,f'{variant}-{treatment}');result['label_grading']=")
end=s.index("\n        path=BASE/",start)
s=s[:start]+"""        result=evaluate(preds,sessions,f'{variant}-{treatment}')
        result['label_target_study']={'variant':variant,'horizon':HORIZONS[variant],'prediction_proof':fingerprint(proof),'formal_baseline':BASELINE_ID,'paired_control':'h20continuous/h20q10' if variant.startswith('sum') else f'h{HORIZONS[variant]}continuous','source_snapshot':'Nov3 raw labels; Nov2 features; Nov3 evaluation','sample_limitation':'Path-sum requires all20 components finite; original H20 endpoint labels use a larger own-valid sample. Their comparison includes sample-composition effects. Sum continuous/q10 share exact mask; terminal H7/H15/H20 q10-vs-continuous pairs each preserve their original own mask.'}
""" +s[end:]
ast.parse(s);(TMP/'evaluate.py').write_text(s);save_source(__file__)
print('Adapted canonical evaluation with five verified reused controls.')
